description:
We are actively seeking a highly skilled and compassionate Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal full-time role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of patient care, foster a culture of excellence, and ensure the highest standards of clinical practice. We are looking for a visionary leader who is passionate about making a significant impact on the lives of residents and staff.

As the DON, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards, and developing a strong, cohesive nursing team. This role requires a leader with exceptional clinical judgment, strong organizational skills, and a commitment to continuous quality improvement. We are eager to fill this position quickly with the right candidate who can contribute to our mission of providing outstanding care.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa.
Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive nursing experience, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory role.
Prior experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility is highly preferred.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Proven ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing staff.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This full-time position offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $95,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
